_doc: The tube family of plain sections, with a starting size (25 x 25 x 2 mm, al6063-t5): a square or rectangular tube. A plain section has no slots and no maker's sheet: give the size, the wall and the material you have (profileModel('tube', { width: 40, height: 20, wall: 2, material: 's275' })), and its area, second moments, torsion constant and mass are worked out from its outline. It is fastened through drilled holes, clamps and printed saddles. The drawn outline leaves out the rounds inside an extruded tube's corners (drawn square inside when corner_radius is 0).
name: profile-tube

family.source: a starting value of the kit's: give your own with profileModel(family, { width, height, wall, material }) or in a set of your own

width.source: a starting value of the kit's: give your own with profileModel(family, { width, height, wall, material }) or in a set of your own

height.source: a starting value of the kit's: give your own with profileModel(family, { width, height, wall, material }) or in a set of your own

wall.rule: Wall thickness, the same all round, to start from
wall.source: a starting value of the kit's: give your own with profileModel(family, { width, height, wall, material }) or in a set of your own

corner_radius.rule: Outside corners of an extruded aluminium tube are nearly square: drawn square. Give the radius where yours is rounded (cold-formed steel tube is, by about twice its wall)
corner_radius.source: the kit's own guess: no sheet is behind it

material.rule: Extruded aluminium, EN AW-6063 T5: one of the alloys such sections are extruded in (6060 and 6063 in Europe, 6061 and 6063 in America). Name the alloy on your supplier's sheet where it matters
material.source: a starting value of the kit's: give your own with profileModel(family, { width, height, wall, material }) or in a set of your own
